nodes.label: Notifiable Transactions
nodes.summary: Classification and requirements for notifiable transactions under MBL Chapter 14, including the percentage ratio tests and corresponding disclosure and approval obligations.

nodes.label: Transaction Classification Framework
nodes.summary: Transactions are classified by percentage ratios: discloseable (5-25%), major (25-100%), and very substantial (100%+). Each classification triggers different announcement, circular, and shareholder approval requirements.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 14.06 — Discloseable Transaction
nodes.summary: A transaction where one or more percentage ratios exceed 5% but are less than 25%. Requires an announcement, but no shareholder approval.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 14.07 — Major Transaction
nodes.summary: A transaction where any percentage ratio exceeds 25% but is less than 100%. Requires announcement, circular, and shareholder approval.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 14.08 — Very Substantial Transaction
nodes.summary: A transaction where any percentage ratio is 100% or more. Requires announcement, circular, and shareholder approval; effectively a reverse takeover may be treated as a new listing.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 14.22 — Aggregation of Transactions
nodes.summary: Transactions completed within 12 months with the same counterparty or involving the same asset must be aggregated for classification purposes.

nodes.label: Percentage Ratio Tests
nodes.summary: The five percentage ratios used for classification: assets ratio, profits ratio, revenue ratio, consideration ratio, and equity capital ratio (MBL Rule 14.04(9)).

nodes.label: MBL Rule 14.04(9) — Percentage Ratios Definition
nodes.summary: Defines the five percentage ratio tests: assets, profits, revenue, consideration, and equity capital.

nodes.label: Shareholder Approval Requirements
nodes.summary: Major and very substantial transactions require shareholder approval. Interested parties (including controlling shareholders and their associates) must abstain from voting.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 14.40 — Voting Requirements
nodes.summary: Shareholder approval must be obtained at a general meeting; any controlling shareholder and its associates must abstain.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 14.42 — Financial Information
nodes.summary: A circular for a major or very substantial transaction must include accountants' reports and pro forma financial information.

nodes.label: Calculate Percentage Ratios
nodes.summary: Step 1: Calculate all five percentage ratios to determine transaction classification.

nodes.label: Classify and Determine Requirements
nodes.summary: Step 2: Classify the transaction; determine whether announcement only, or announcement + circular + shareholder approval is required.

nodes.label: Draft and Publish Announcement
nodes.summary: Step 3: Draft announcement with prescribed disclosures, publish via HKEX.

nodes.label: Circular and Shareholder Meeting (if applicable)
nodes.summary: Step 4: For major/very substantial transactions, dispatch circular, convene general meeting, and obtain approval.
